items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: My teacher, Manuel Moneta, was playing.

ctx.x: It was closed. Now you see, you get to the Gyp the Blood killing. You remember the Gyp the Blood killing? I heard about it. Well that was about 1913, wasn't it, I think, you know. My teacher, Manuel Moneta, was playing.
He was playing across the street. Yeah, Manuel still plays piano.
